verdict.rationale: Brevo documents revenue attribution to campaigns, which covers the conversions part of the story. It also documents an export of raw transactional events from the past 7 days for analytics reports, but that is transactional rather than campaign data and is limited in time range. Nothing in the evidence shows per-campaign or per-automation-step reporting of opens, clicks and unsubscribes over time. Missing for 10: documented per-campaign open/click/unsubscribe reports, per-automation-step metrics, time-series trend views, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can read opens, clicks, unsubscribes, and conversions per campaign and per automation step, over time

citations.quote: Track customer behavior and attribute revenue to campaigns.
Generate reports with unaggregated data for analytics.
